correctness.rationale: A fresh independent replay from the archived icosahedral edge list generated all 264 nonempty neighborhood-complex faces with f-vector 12,60,120,60,12. Rebuilding the documented vertex-toggle order gives exactly 120 matched covers and leaves one critical zero-simplex plus twenty-three critical two-simplices. The orientation of all 780 Hasse covers is acyclic under a complete topological sort. Forman theory therefore gives a wedge of twenty-three two-spheres. The package's mod-two Betti vector is an independent consistency check, not the sole homotopy argument.
